text: The Emergency Flood Assistance Project (EFAP) is a multi-agency initiative financed by the Asian Development Bank to aid Pakistan's recovery from the 2022 flood catastrophe. With a budget of $531 million, EFAP focuses on restoring connectivity through roads and bridges, improving water availability and flood protection for agriculture, and implementing multi-hazard-resilient design standards. The project involves federal and provincial components, with significant roles played by the National Highway Authority and provincial governments.
